newsitem.title: UK: Zeneca to build Zomig plant in Puerto Rico.
newsitem.headline: Zeneca to build Zomig plant in Puerto Rico.

text.p: British pharmaceutical firm Zeneca Group Plc said on Thursday it would build a 10 million stg plant in Puerto Rico to provide global supply of its migraine drug, Zomig.
Zeneca planned to build the new facilities next to its existing purification plant in Guayama, Puerto Rico.
The company bought zolmitriptan, the active ingredient in Zomig, from Glaxo Wellcome in September 1996.
The new plant, due to open by the end of 1998, will have several times the capacity for peak demands of Zomig, which is currently available in the UK and Sweden.
The company expected regulatory approvals in other countries throughout 1997/98.
